block.title: Panorama banner: the Verge's nine worlds as one scrolling horizon
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, extreme widescreen 21:9 side-scrolling panorama, subtle CRT scanline glow; marketing banner art, ultra-detailed large-format background with clean vector shapes and pixel-art texture accents. One continuous horizontal world-strip that secretly contains nine: reading left to right, a planet-rim of blue sky over green-teal highland terrain with drifting star dust; dissolving through a wobbling teal-violet gas sea where a stone reef-arch sinks into sand-gold fog; into a twin-sunned desert of long dune shadows, a big pale cream sun and small orange one stacked in heat haze; hard-cut by an erupting ridge of black peaks over a molten lake glowing under its own smoke; rising into a saw-tooth snow range beneath a roiling storm deck lit by one violet bolt; melting downward into the walls of a living green-cell vault, tissue ridges breathing in the dark; refracting into a corridor of violet crystal facets with cubes suspended mid-stack; clanging shut as the riveted amber corridor of a steel fortress interior, pipe rows converging; and finally sinking, right at the frame's edge, into a black-blue abyss of rock spires dusted with cold cyan lights. At the exact center, small, flying right through all of it on one straight line, a steel-blue dart fighter with a cyan canopy and a single long orange contrail that visibly passes through every biome — the same ship, the same horizon, nine deaths of palette. The contrail is the only line in the image allowed to be perfectly straight. Deep-navy unifier in every shadow, never pure black. No text, no letters, no UI.

block.notes: Each zone's anchor hue follows the 00-style-kernel table. Nine distinct biomes in one strip is a stress test — flux.2 merges adjacent palettes most gracefully; expect sd3.5 to merge the storm/snow and vault/crystal boundaries into mush and accept 7-8 readable zones if it fights. Straight contrail = the "one run" promise; if it bends, regenerate. Best use: Steam header, YouTube channel art, press-kit width.
